title: 第3章 孤王有一剑名曰 开天第4章 怼继续怼太上
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第3章孤王有一剑，名曰：开天！人族圣母，
你也配！
帝辛舌绽惊雷，字字诛鸡！
一瞬间，
整个朝歌所有人全都愣住了，脑海中回荡着刚刚帝辛那振聋发聩的话！
就在这时，
帝辛依旧平视着女娲，背脊挺得如同标枪般笔直，
一字一顿地质问道：“无数先祖葬身妖口时，你不在！无数人族死于饥寒交迫时，你不在！洪荒人族被天庭当成香火傀儡时，你不在！”
“孤王只是题了一首诗，你却来了！”
“独享人族一半气运强大自身，任凭人族被当成血食、死于灾害、化身傀儡，你依旧高高在上，就因为你是圣人，圣人就该高高在上，享受人间的供奉和香火，让人族拿出最真挚的信仰供养你们！”
“可在你眼里，人族万万年的挣扎和死亡，却比不上孤王一首诗！”
“你自己说，人族圣母——你配吗？”
……
无数先祖葬身妖口时，
你不在！
无数人族死于饥寒交迫时，
你不在！
洪荒人族被天庭当成香火傀儡时，
你不在！
这样的人族圣母，配吗？

不配！
她不配！！！
在这一刻，
朝歌城中无数人的心里，全都在嘶吼，
他们愤怒地盯着空中的那道身影，脑海中回荡着人皇对其的质问，
人族传承了千万年的委屈以及不甘，迅速在他们心里化成了三个字——你！不！配！
这时，
帝辛再度剑指女娲，杀气腾腾道：“女娲，水能载舟、亦能覆舟，你之所以成圣，皆是因为人族，希望你不要舍本逐末，不然，孤王亲手将你打落圣人果位！”
最后一句，
是帝辛吹牛逼的！
因为他发现刚刚那诛心三问，已经调动起了众人的情绪，再加上知道自己怎么浪都不会死，那就继续吹呗。
content_en:
Chapter 3 The lonely king has a sword called: Kaitian! Our Lady of Humanity,
You deserve it too!
Emperor Xin's tongue exploded with thunder, and he killed the chicken every word!
for a moment,
Everyone in Chaoge was stunned, with Di Xin's deafening words just now echoing in their minds!
Just then,
Di Xin still looked straight at Nuwa, his back as straight as a javelin.
He asked one word at a time: "When countless ancestors were buried in the mouth of the demon, you were not there! When countless human races died of hunger and cold, you were not there! When the ancient human race was used as incense puppets by the heaven, you were not there!"
"The lonely king just wrote a poem, but you are here!"
"Exclusively owning half of the destiny of the human race to strengthen yourself, even if the human race is treated as blood food, died in disasters, and turned into a puppet, you are still aloof, just because you are a saint. A saint should be aloof, enjoy the offerings and incense of the world, and let the humans support you with their most sincere faith!"
"But in your eyes, the human race's struggle and death for thousands of years are not as good as a poem by the lonely king!"
"Say it yourself, Holy Mother of the Human Race - are you worthy?"
…
When countless ancestors were buried in the demon mouth,
You're not here!
When countless human beings died of hunger and cold,
You're not here!
When the ancient human race was treated as incense puppets by Heaven,
You're not here!
Is such a human saint worthy?
Not worthy!
She doesn't deserve it! ! !
at this moment,
Countless people in Chaoge City are roaring in their hearts,
They stared angrily at the figure in the sky, with the Human Emperor's questions echoing in their minds.
The grievances and unwillingness that the human race has inherited for thousands of years quickly turned into three words in their hearts - you! No! match!
At this time,
Emperor Xin once again pointed his sword at Nuwa, and said with murderous intent: "Nuwa, water can carry a boat, but it can also capsize a boat. The reason why you became a saint is because of the human race. I hope you will not abandon your roots and chase the bottom, otherwise, the lonely king will knock you down from the status of saint with his own hands!"
The last sentence,
It was Di Xin who was bragging!
Because he found that the three heart-breaking questions just now had aroused everyone's emotions, and he knew that he would not die no matter what, he continued to brag.
